content.value:
. An ideal gas turbine cycle with two stages of compression and two stages of expansion 12   
has a pressure ratio of 2.83 in each stage. Air enters each stage of the compressor at   
300 K and cach stage of the turbine at 1300 K. Determine the back work ratio and the   
thermal efficiency of this gas turbine cycle assuming (i) no regenerator, and (ii) an ideal   
regenerator with 100% effectiveness.
